getting_there.text: Limited parking; public transport recommended. Great World MRT TE15 Exits 2/6 through mall to Zion Road near PS Café, about 400m/six-minute walk. Bus stop B13121 Opp Great World City one minute away; buses 75, 970, 16, 175, 195 listed.

sacraments.text: For children younger than seven. Next published date 8 November 2026; applications close 15th of preceding month. Mandatory parents/godparents briefing Sunday 15:00 one week before baptism. Submit form, child birth certificate, parents’ marriage certificate, Catholic parent baptism certificate and godparents’ confirmation certificates. Godparents at least 16, fully initiated/practising, Catholic-married if married.
Contact parish at least 12 months ahead; all couples take MPC, Catholic Engaged Encounter or approved Couple Mentor Journey.
Contact parish for anointing, Eucharist for the sick, Viaticum and reconciliation; page encourages arranging while person can still pray with priest.
Office coordinates funeral and Prayer @ Wake ministry. No wake parlour on church grounds.
Youth: four-year programme from Level 7 to Level 10 (around 16). Adults 18+ may prepare through RCIA.

Flexible staged journey for adults 18+; introduction generally first Wednesday, subject to signups and confirmation. Published 7 October and 4 November 2026 at 19:45 in Conference Room above parish office; FAQ instead says 20:00, confirm. Sponsors also welcome.
